titleByLocale.it: Gestione dei dati e delle analisi (DAG)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity The Data and Analytics Governance (DAG) Lead is a key role responsible for establishing and maintaining effective data & analytics governance practices for Roche’s Digital Backbone (Enterprise Resource Planning environment) and the Finance, Procurement and Roche Solution and Services Domain, working closely with cross-functional teams in ASPIRE program (implementing and deploying the Digital Backbone to all Roche affiliates), Roche Data Office, Informatics and Enterprise Master Data Management (EMDM) to ensure the consistent application of Functional DAG policies, standards and controls derived out of the Global Guidelines from the Roche Data Office.
• Align, Develop and implement a comprehensive DAG Framework, including data policies, standards, and procedures in alignment with the Roche Data Council's policies, standards and procedures.
• Implement and further develop the Framework`s data and analytics -related roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities
• Develop and implement a comprehensive DAG Cookbook, including metadata management guidance
• Build and maintain up to date metadata repository, data lineage, monitor data quality, integrity, and security measures in collaboration with data stewards, data owners, and Informatics teams
• Facilitate DAG meetings, Stakeholder alignment meetings and closely collaborate with the Roche Data Council
• Manage Business Data Stewardship from a Product Owner perspective, including Strategy, Roadmap and Objectives for Data Analytics and Governance (DAG), aligned with Group Data Strategy Who you are
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Management, or a related field
• 5+ years of experience in data management, governance, or analytics roles
• Strong understanding of data architecture, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts
• Familiarity with data governance frameworks and standards (e.g., DAMA)
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
• Effective communication and facilitation skills to engage stakeholders at all levels
• Project management experience and the ability to juggle multiple priorities
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging data and analytics governance frameworks to continuously improve DAG Roche’s Digital Backbone approach
• Excellent understanding of Data & Analytics, Pharmaceutical Business Processes, Data Governance Solutions (e.g. Collibra) In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive cult
